items.title: Thank You and Some Perspective about the Recent Shareholder Vote
items.summary: I want to sincerely thank all of the shareholders who participated in our Special Meeting. Your vote prevented a reverse stock split — we passed Proposal 2 with 50.08% of the outstanding shares. Every single vote mattered.

items.title: Update on Voting (with DEGIRO) in Europe
items.summary: Voting via DEGIRO is no longer possible as they require weeks of notice prior to the Special Meeting.

items.title: Let us Close this Out – Vote Yes on Proposal 2
items.summary: Based on the most recent preliminary tabulation, approximately 49.7% of the outstanding shares have voted FOR Proposal 2. We need a majority of the outstanding shares (50% plus one share) to get this done.

items.title: How European Shareholders Can Vote Their Plug Power Shares

items.title: Just an Update on the Vote for Proposal 2 – We’re within ~1% of Securing the Vote
items.summary: We are making good progress toward securing approval of Proposal 2, the increase in the number of authorized shares available for issuance.

items.title: Some Clarification on a Reverse Stock Split
items.summary: There seems to be confusion about whether the company will do a reverse stock split. Let me clarify.

items.title: Protecting Shareholder Value – Why I am asking for a Yes Vote
items.summary: We are asking you to vote YES on Proposal 2, which increases the number of authorized shares.

items.title: To Our International Shareholders
items.summary: We do know that many of our long-time investors in Europe are having a hard time voting. In many cases, European brokers actually require investors to pay to vote. It doesn’t feel right, but that is the reality. Our team is actively working with our lawyers and our outside proxy solicitors to see if there is a way to address this issue, but this is a challenge.

items.title: The Exponential Power of Your Vote
items.summary: Retail investors can have unusual power when voting on a routine proposal. Proposal 2—the increase in the number of authorized shares—is a routine proposal. Let me explain why your vote matters more than you might think.

items.title: We are Close on Proposal 2 – But We Still Need Your Help
items.summary: We encourage those who haven’t voted yet to vote yes on Proposal 2. And for those who voted no, you can still change to yes.
